headline: Falcons at Packers: Penix returns for Week 3 kickoff under Lambeau lights
whyCareReason: Michael Penix Jr. returns from a torn ACL to start for Atlanta, while Jordan Love leads the 1-1 Packers on Alumni Weekend under the Lambeau lights.
teaser: Thursday 24 September, 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video. Penix starts for Atlanta; Love leads Green Bay. Week 3 opens at historic Lambeau Field.
story:
Why this one matters: Thursday Night Football opens Week 3 with major storylines on both sidelines at iconic Lambeau Field.

NFL.com and Sports Illustrated confirm that Michael Penix Jr. will make his eagerly anticipated return to the starting lineup for Atlanta after recovering from a torn ACL, stepping in for Cooper Rush. The Falcons arrive 0-2 and hungry to jumpstart their season on national television.

Green Bay enters 1-1 following a gritty 20-17 overtime triumph over the Jets in Week 2. With more than 50 alumni in attendance honoring the anniversaries of Super Bowl I and Super Bowl XXXI, Jordan Love and the Packers look to defend their home turf on a short week.
stakes: Atlanta battles to avoid an 0-3 start while Green Bay looks to claim early supremacy in the NFC North.
rivalryAngle: An NFC clash between cold-weather tradition and dynamic southern speed under prime-time lights.
